voice.title: Neural Voiceover
voice.automatic: Automatic: Chatterbox's stock voice (Kokoro Heart if Chatterbox cannot run)

music.title: Music Composer
music.lyricsEmptyInstrumental: Leave empty for an instrumental. Section tags like [Verse] and [Chorus] shape the song.
music.lyricsEmptyPlanner: Leave empty and the planner writes some.
music.polishHelpAce15: Fills in tempo, key, meter, language and length, shortens long section tags and sketches the timing. Your style and words go to the model as typed.
music.polishHelpTags: Turns your style into the tags ACE-Step v1 reads.
music.plannerRewriteHelp: The planner writes its own caption, tempo and key, and lyrics if you leave them empty. The same text can come back different each time.
music.polishedKeepsWords: Your style and words are unchanged.
music.polishedNoModel: The chat model did not answer, so only the length and timing sketch were set. Turn it on under Plugins, or set the rest yourself.
music.polishedTooLong: These lyrics need more than 4 minutes at this tempo, so some lines may be skipped. Shorten them or raise the tempo.
music.directHint: This goes to the model exactly as typed. Nothing rewrites it, and the same seed gives the same song.
music.directFieldsHint: A blank BPM, Key or Meter reaches the model as N/A.
music.seedHelp: Blank picks a new one each time.
music.audioSketchHelp: Your words stay as typed and more of the lyrics get sung. It also picks any BPM, Key or Meter left blank.
music.captionOver: {{label}}. The model stops reading there, so the end of your text, BPM, Key and Meter never reach it.
music.lyricsOver: Lyrics: {{tokens}} of {{limit}} tokens. The model stops reading there.
music.describeHint: Describe the song in a sentence. Name a bpm or a key if you want them kept.
music.englishByDefault: Songs are sung in English unless you choose another language. To hear yours, pick {{language}} under $t(audio.music.language) on the card after $t(audio.music.arrange).
